text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's the matter, Fukukitaru?<n>We just
wanted to wish you a—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
P-p-please, no more! Sorry, but... I<n>really must ask
you to stop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You see, today's... just been such a<n>happy day,
and if you two were to<n>wish me a happy birthday
on top of<n>that... that amount of happiness, i-it<n>would...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It would trigger a reversal of fortune!<n>Who knows
what manner of<n>calamities would await me
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday... We can't just<n>ignore your special
day, so you'll<n>have to deal with it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, even if misfortune comes<n>your way or
whatever... we can just<n>face it together, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm as happy as can be<n>today!
